title: Output Capsule Elicitation
description: Capture what good output looks like: structure, citation behavior, length, register, refusal rules, and review contract.

stages.title: Exemplar Upload
question_templates: Share a strong exemplar of the desired output.
What should PRAXIS copy from this example and what should it ignore?
completion_criteria: At least one exemplar is source-linked.
Transferable and non-transferable traits are separated.

stages.title: Structure
question_templates: Which sections are optional, forbidden, or conditional?

stages.title: Citation, Register, And Length
question_templates: How long should the output be and what register should it use?

criteria.description: At least five output contract rules are captured.
At least two citation or source-display rules are captured.
